# Pinned to EXACT versions (2026-07-23) instead of the previous ">=" floors --
# trader.yml runs `pip install -r requirements.txt` fresh on every single
# invocation with no lockfile, so an unpinned floor means a new major/minor
# release of either package could silently change behavior mid-trading-day
# with zero code change on your end. Bump these deliberately (test locally,
# then update the pin) rather than letting pip pick whatever's newest each run.
requests==2.31.0
pyotp==2.9.0

# --- Part 11 (Quant Intelligence) + Part 11.5 (News Intelligence) --------
# Both engines ship their own scoped requirements.txt under
# app/engines/quant_intelligence/ and app/engines/news_intelligence/
# respectively (kept there so each engine's OWN dependency list stays the
# single source of truth for what that engine needs) -- but trader.yml
# only ever runs `pip install -r requirements.txt` at the repo root, so
# those nested files were never being installed automatically. This is
# what caused the "PyYAML is required..." startup warning seen in CI --
# News Intelligence degraded gracefully (as designed) rather than
# crashing the run, but was silently non-functional. Merged here, once,
# so a single `pip install -r requirements.txt` covers every engine.
# Do not remove without also adding an explicit nested-requirements
# install step to trader.yml.
#
# PyYAML: required by BOTH engines (quant_intelligence/utils/config_loader.py
# and news_intelligence/config/loader.py each parse their own settings.yaml).
# pydantic: news_intelligence's settings.yaml validation (config/loader.py);
# also usable as a documented drop-in upgrade path for quant_intelligence's
# dataclass models (see quant_intelligence/README.md "Pydantic note") -- not
# required by quant_intelligence today, only pinned for news_intelligence.
# beautifulsoup4: news_intelligence's RBI/SEBI providers (no JSON API exists
# for either source, so those two scrape public HTML listing pages).
PyYAML==6.0.1
pydantic==2.7.1
beautifulsoup4==4.12.3
